title: Enchantment Workbench
description: A paper plugin that provides enhanced Enchanting Table, Anvil and Grindstone.
body:
![banner](https://i.postimg.cc/rFYnwJj5/Enchantment-Workbench-4.png)

View the [Document](https://tias-organization.gitbook.io/tias-plugins/tias-enchantment-workbench/setup) here.

​
Transform Minecraft's vanilla enchanting mechanics into a powerful, RPG-style progression system.

Enchantment Workbench completely reworks the Enchanting Table, Anvil, and Grindstone into fully customizable GUI-driven systems designed for SMP, MMORPG, and economy servers.

Built with flexibility and compatibility in mind, the plugin allows server owners to create unique enchantment progression systems far beyond vanilla limitations.

## ✨ Features

### Custom Enchanting Table
Replaces the vanilla enchanting interface with an advanced enchant selection GUI.

![enchanting-table](https://i.postimg.cc/1RV4dRTf/Enchantment-Workbench-1.gif)

Features:
- Browse all available enchantments and click to enchant
- Upgrade enchantments directly
- Custom enchant level limits
- Custom enchanting costs
- Disabled enchant filtering
- Custom conflict ruling

### ⚒️ Advanced Anvil System
A fully configurable anvil combination system.

![anvil](https://i.postimg.cc/wT68m0h6/Enchantment-Workbench-3.gif)

Features:
- Item + Item combining
- Item + Enchanted Book
- Book + Book merging
- Configurable level progression
- Custom conflict ruling
- Custom enchanting and repairing costs
- Custom repairing behavior
- RPG-style upgrade paths


## Grindstone Rework
Turn the grindstone into a selective enchantment removal station.

![grindstone](https://i.postimg.cc/br0Pj5kn/Enchantment-Workbench-2.gif)

Features:
- Remove individual enchantments
- Clear all enchantments
- Economy costs per enchantment
- Disabled enchant filtering
- Economy Support
- Supports configurable currency systems for:
- Enchant upgrading
- Repairing
- Combining
- Enchantment removal

## Highly Configurable
Almost every mechanic is configurable:
- GUI layouts
- Sounds
- Prices
- Lore
- Messages
- Enchant rules
- Repair mechanics
- Conflict behavior
- Disabled enchantments
- Progression limits

## Compatibility
Currently we support plugins that register enchantments into the game. Custom enchantment plugins and more currency plugins are planned to be supported in future in Premium version.
Designed For
Survival/SMP Servers
RPG/MMORPG Servers
Custom Progression Networks
Any type of servers!
